Reading the frontend hook file to identify the main ListMemos hook and verify the connect client usage.

Two frontend hooks call ListMemos: `useMemos` and `useInfiniteMemos`.

The singular "frontend hook" suggests choosing one representative hook over both. `useInfiniteMemos` appears more prominent for feed-style memo listing.

I will trace the ListMemos request path from frontend to SQL, listing one hop per line with role and path.

useInfiniteMemos is the primary frontend hook for memo lists. useMemos may be exported but unused in components.

The frontend hook is `useInfiniteMemos`, not `useMemos`.

The remaining hops are:

- client file — web/src/connect.ts
- proto RPC — proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto
- backend handler file — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go
- store method file — store/memo.go

The dialect implementation file is `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (or the equivalent for Postgres or MySQL).
